snapshot.title: Bug: widget stuck on redacted placeholder on both platforms; config picker mislabeled "No Tags" and dismisses empty
snapshot.body_digest: Both widgets render WidgetKit's placeholder entry under placeholder redaction instead of real tasks; iOS chrome draws but all Text is redaction pills matching WidgetSnapshotSamples.placeholder exactly; macOS renders an empty grey rect. WidgetUnavailableView never appears, so timeline(for:in:) is not completing usably rather than returning nil. Config picker labeled "No Tags" (a label no widget-target symbol can produce; the repo's only "Tags" parameter is AddTaskIntent.tags in ShortcutsActions) and self-dismisses. Regression, exact introducing build unknown; boundary window 2026-07-21 (LIL-4 verified good) to 2026-07-29 (build 92 / v0.19.0 observed bad).
